<a id="node-video"></a>
### `Video` (`video`)

`VideoPlayer`. Its changed trigger reports ready/error and, when ready, durationSeconds/positionSeconds without autoplay; with reportIntervalMs, also positionSeconds/playing while it plays.

- Written `Video`. Level 4 (Full vocabulary).
- Takes no quoted string.
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | text | `""` | 4 | A remote HTTPS MP4, WebM, MOV or M4V URL. |
| `autoPlay` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 4 |  |
| `showControls` | `true`/`false` | `true` | 4 |  |
| `playing` | `true`/`false` |  | 4 | Null leaves playback to the built-in controls. Bind or set explicitly to play/pause from application actions; browser gesture rules still apply. |
| `positionSeconds` | number (≥ 0) |  | 4 | Absolute source-media time in seconds; null leaves the current time alone. |
| `volume` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `1` | 4 |  |
| `loop` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 4 |  |
| `fit` | `fill` `contain` `cover` `fitWidth` `fitHeight` `none` `scaleDown` | `contain` | 4 | How the picture fills the node (`FittedBox`): `contain` letterboxes, `cover` fills and crops. |
| `poster` | text | `""` | 4 | An image URL shown until the video has its first frame (and while a new source loads), instead of a spinner. |
| `syncTolerance` | number (≥ 0) | `0.3` | 4 | While playing, a changed `positionSeconds` seeks only when the video is more than this many seconds away from it, so a position bound to a running clock corrects drift instead of stalling the video with a seek every frame. Paused, every change seeks (the latest one wins). |
| `reportIntervalMs` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` | 4 | While playing, fires the changed trigger every this many milliseconds with `positionSeconds` and `playing` (0: off): the video as a clock. |
